title: A local Penrose inequality for conformal perturbations of Schwarzschild–anti-de Sitter data
coverage: Read in full: Sections 0, 1, 4, 5 and 6, the statement and proof start of the CMC jet construction, the CMC Hawking variation lemma, the leading-energy proposition (Sec 3), and the expansions proposition (Sec 2). Checks by sympy or by hand: (1) Setting: the conformal scalar and momentum constraints; the boundary mean curvature and tr_S K giving theta_+=0; kappa=(1+3a^2)/(2a); b_*(4 pi a^2)=m0; b_*'=kappa/8pi; the B components and the Jacobi operator J_s^0, with J_0^0=D and D_1=6m0/a^3. (2) Quadratic coefficient: the TT square identity, including the boundary sign (nu=-n, omega=-kappa v n); the boundary area-gap sign and the -kappa/16pi contribution; the dipole cancellation 3+2/r^2-p'-3p^2=3m0/r^3, giving h_s=-2u and h(0)=-v(0); the Hawking-mass derivative formula (sympy) and the N r^2/2 prefactor that yields N/16pi(|k|^2+|U|^2+2FJF). (3) Quartic coefficient: re-derived the degree-2 graph second form k from the Gaussian evolution, including the conformal Christoffel term, [dt K]_1=2Hess u-6u g0, and the trace Lw+12uv-2<du,dv>; the metric 2-jet -2vq-Bv^2-dv⊗dv; the null-cut orders (chi=O_tot(2), theta=O_tot(5)) and the cut area preserved through degree 4; H(S#)=eps^2 k_ss and its sign; the Lie-derivative-plus-trace reduction; the full Y2 projection system and its solution d, p, c; the identity (V'-NV/r)^2=6m0V^2/r^3, by hand; the Gronwall step through z=V/r. (4) Radial case: dM/dl=0 (sympy); the MOTS boundary value M=R(1+R^2)/2; the asymptotics 1+R^2-Rdot^2=(2m0+16c)/r; the flux computation p0-m0=8c. Read but not re-derived: the weighted comparison/inverse lemma, the Green representation of the mass, rotation approximation and coefficient continuity, the CMC jet existence and boost/asymptotic frame selection at infinity, and the round-jet lemma's Hodge decomposition details. Non-gap remark: the Corollary's hypothesis q_ss>=0 is never used.
main_claim: Fix a time-symmetric Schwarzschild-AdS exterior with a minimal boundary, a decaying TT seed q, and any branch of the conformal constraint solutions with conformal second fundamental form eps*q. For all sufficiently small eps, the AH mass norm satisfies m_AH(eps) >= sqrt(A/16pi)(1+A/4pi), where A is the area of the MOTS boundary. Equality holds exactly for radial seeds and the inequality is strict otherwise. The proof uses a nonnegative quadratic coefficient (from the TT square identity and the CMC Hawking mass), a 4-dimensional kernel, and a strictly positive quartic coefficient on the dipole kernel directions, obtained by a change of slice.
